# Phygital Fashion Lab

> 3D garment development for the fashion industry: garment patterns, virtual fitting, technical documentation and 3D visualization from independent specialists with real pattern-making and production experience. Works remotely with brands, designers and agencies. Languages: English, Russian.

## Main pages
- [Phygital Fashion Lab (English)](https://phygitalfashionlab.com/): services, team, how we work, client testimonials, FAQ and contacts
- [Phygital Fashion Lab (Russian)](https://phygitalfashionlab.com/ru/): the same in Russian

## Guides
- [Custom 3D Avatar](https://phygitalfashionlab.com/custom-avatars/): custom 3D avatars for CLO3D and Style3D made from a 3D scan or 4 photos and check measurements: how it works, three types compared (avatar for brands, personal avatar, basic avatar/mannequin: software, accuracy, symmetry, mesh, file size, recommended use) and a free downloadable photo and measurement guide ([Russian version](https://phygitalfashionlab.com/ru/custom-avatars/))
- [Technical Drawing & Garment Description](https://phygitalfashionlab.com/sketch-to-technical-design/): the Sketch to Technical Design service: a rough sketch or idea turned into a technical drawing and a detailed garment description for the pattern maker, technologist and production, plus a photorealistic image to evaluate the look; how it works and two examples (top with a longline vest, Crystal bridal gown) ([Russian version](https://phygitalfashionlab.com/ru/sketch-to-technical-design/))

## Case studies
- [The Phoenix Jacket: 3D Prototyping Case Study](https://phygitalfashionlab.com/portfolio/3d-patterns-phoenix-jacket/): patterns for a jacket by MILLA BERILLO DESIGN BUREAU (2025), developed in 3D in Style3D from the designer's sketch, approved step by step via video previews, checked against a muslin fitting and delivered as print-ready PDF patterns ([Russian version](https://phygitalfashionlab.com/ru/portfolio/3d-patterns-phoenix-jacket/))
- [Gazprom Media Merch Dress for SPIEF: 3D Fitting Case Study](https://phygitalfashionlab.com/portfolio/3d-fitting-gazprom-media-dress/): a merch dress for Gazprom Media at SPIEF (2026), done as part of the Factory Base team: developed in three weeks around 3D fitting, with AI-enhanced renders for client review; approved after the first physical sample ([Russian version](https://phygitalfashionlab.com/ru/portfolio/3d-fitting-gazprom-media-dress/))
- [3D Visualization for CGI Videos: Showreel, Process Details & 3D Model Views](https://phygitalfashionlab.com/portfolio/3d-visualization-cgi-showreel/): garments and accessories in 3D for CGI videos by Visual Bakery (2025): showreel; a blouse for Love Republic (photo reference vs 3D render, texture created in Substance Designer); a sneaker and a bag for Stockmann (CLO3D); a hoodie for Fonbet (animation rendered in Blender, colorways from CLO3D); interactive 3D models of each ([Russian version](https://phygitalfashionlab.com/ru/portfolio/3d-visualization-cgi-showreel/))
